title: TCL 50P735 BeyondTV4 (Smart TV Pro, Android 11, SDK 30) debloat list
notes:
TCL 50P735 BeyondTV4 (Smart TV Pro, Android 11, SDK 30) debloat list
Shared by one owner (#911); the firmware build and a reboot check were not reported, so treat it as provisional
and compare with tcl-50c725k/ and tcl-55p638/ (same BeyondTV4 family).

Apply: TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-50p735/debloat.txt
Undo:  TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-50p735/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.
com.tcl.versionUpdateApp is TCL's firmware updater: this owner turned it off; re-enable it to take an update.
